extraction_notes: Robusta 'Rob Cherry' coffee, not roasted, PB (peaberry) Grade. Dry-processed (cherry) Indian Robusta; subheading 0901.11 = not decaffeinated.
Other cinnamon (heading 0906), neither crushed nor ground — whole quills/bark other than the named cassia/cinnamon sublines.
Saffron stamen (0910.20.20) — the stamen portion of saffron, distinct from the prized stigma. Kashmir saffron grade split.
Preparations with a basis of coffee extracts/essences/concentrates or of coffee (2101.12) — e.g., instant coffee mixes, coffee-chicory blends with a coffee basis.
Chilli sauce (2103.90.20) — prepared sauce under 'Other' of heading 2103.
Compound preparations for making non-alcoholic beverages (2106.90.50) — soft-drink concentrates / flavour bases not elsewhere specified.
Other peat (2703.00.90) — including peat litter and agglomerated peat other than the bale-form line. Heading 2703 covers peat whether or not agglomerated.
Fuel oil conforming to IS 1593, Grade HV (2710.19.59) — heavy petroleum fuel oil, >=70% petroleum oils, non-crude. India IS-grade split.
Lignite wax / montan wax (2712.90.20) — mineral wax extracted from lignite; used in polishes, carbon papers, leather finishing.
Sulphuric acid (H2SO4) (2807.00.10) — the named acid as opposed to the oleum sub-line. Source spelling 'Sulphurc' is an OCR typo.
Bromates and perbromates (2829.90.20) — bromine V/VII oxoanion salts (e.g., potassium bromate); strong oxidisers. Composition left generic (Br,O) as the cation varies.

Noble metal solutions of platinum, rhodium and palladium (2843.90.12) — compounds of precious metals in solution, used for plating/catalysis. Heading 2843 = inorganic/organic compounds of precious metals.
Chlorofluorobenzene (2903.99.10) — halogenated aromatic hydrocarbon under 2903.99 'Halogenated derivatives of aromatic hydrocarbons, other'. Building-block intermediate.
Hexamethylenediamine and its salts (2921.22) — HMDA, an acyclic polyamine; key monomer for nylon-6,6 (with adipic acid).
1-Amino-4-methylpiperazine (2933.59.40) — nitrogen-heterocycle containing a piperazine ring; pharma intermediate (e.g., for rifampicin synthesis).
Vinyl acetate copolymers, other (3905.29.00) — in primary forms, other than in aqueous dispersion. Heading 3905 = polymers of vinyl acetate/other vinyl esters.
Floor/wall/ceiling coverings of polymers of vinyl chloride, other (3918.10.90) — PVC vinyl flooring in rolls/tiles, residual under 3918.10.
Sacks and bags of poly(vinyl chloride) (3923.29.10) — PVC packaging sacks/bags under 3923.29 'of other plastics'.
Vanity-cases with outer surface of leather or composition leather (4202.11.60) — trunk/case group of heading 4202.
Vanity-bags with outer surface of sheeting of plastics or of textile materials (4202.22.40) — handbag group of heading 4202.
Belts and bandoliers of leather or composition leather (4203.30.00) — clothing accessories of heading 4203. Wearable accessory.
Raw furskins of fox, whole, with or without head/tail/paws (4301.60.00) — untanned fox pelts for furriers' use.
Tanned or dressed furskins — heads, tails, paws and other pieces or cuttings, not assembled (4302.20.00).
Other articles of furskin (4303.90.90) — non-apparel furskin articles n.e.s. (e.g., rugs, decorative items). Residual under 4303.90.
Polypropylene single filament yarn with twist >50 tpm, not put up for retail sale (5402.53.00). Synthetic filament yarn of heading 5402.
Nylon georgette (5407.41.12) — woven fabric >=85% nylon/polyamide filaments, unbleached or bleached. Crepe-weave georgette dress fabric.
Rayon suitings (5408.22.16) — dyed woven fabric of artificial (viscose rayon) filament, >=85% artificial filament. Suiting-weight dress material.
Synthetic staple fibres of polypropylene (5503.40.00), not carded/combed/otherwise processed for spinning. Heading 5503 = synthetic staple fibre.
Woven fabric of synthetic staple fibres >=85% (other than polyester/acrylic), dyed (5512.99.10). Under 5512.99 'Other: Other'.
Other woven fabric of synthetic staple fibres mixed mainly/solely with man-made filaments, other finish (5515.91.90). Residual under 5515.91.
Men's/boys' knitted ensembles of other textile materials, other (6103.29.90). Heading 6103 = knitted/crocheted men's/boys' suits & ensembles.
Women's/girls' knitted slips and petticoats of silk (6108.19.10) — under 6108.19 'of other textile materials', Indian silk sub-line.
Other panty hose and tights of synthetic fibres, single yarn <67 decitex (6115.21.00) — fine-denier knitted hosiery of heading 6115.
Men's/boys' woven jackets and blazers of wool or fine animal hair, other (6203.31.90). Heading 6203 = woven men's/boys' suits, jackets, etc.
Men's/boys' woven nightshirts and pyjamas of man-made fibres (6207.22.00). Heading 6207 = woven men's/boys' underwear & sleepwear.
Shawls/scarves of synthetic fibres, embroidered with Lucknow Chikan Craft (6214.30.10) — India-specific GI handicraft sub-line of heading 6214.
Ingots of high carbon steel (7206.10.20) — iron and non-alloy steel in ingot primary form. High-carbon quality split. Numeric carbon_pct not stated so left null.
U sections of iron or non-alloy steel, hot-rolled/drawn/extruded, height >=80mm, not further worked (7216.31.00). Structural channel/U-beams.
Flat-rolled products of other alloy steel, width <600mm, not further worked than hot-rolled, other (7226.91.90). Residual under 7226.91. Specific alloy pcts not stated, left null.
Other seamless drill pipe of a kind used in drilling for oil or gas (7304.23.90). Heading 7304 = seamless tubes/pipes of iron (non-cast) or steel.
Tin plate containers (7310.29.10) — iron/steel cans of capacity <50 l, tin-coated. Heading 7310 = small tanks/cans/boxes <=300 l.
Iron or steel wool; pot scourers and scouring or polishing pads, gloves and the like (7323.10.00). Household cleaning articles of heading 7323.
Other pump for dispensing fuel or lubricants, of the type used in filling-stations/garages (8413.11.99) — residual under 8413.11 'pumps fitted with measuring device'.
Cotton spinning machines: roving frames (8445.20.14) — textile spinning machine of heading 8445. India sub-line.
Word-processing machines (8472.90.91) — other office machines of heading 8472. India sub-line under 8472.90 'Other'.
Parts of electric motor, other (8503.00.29) — parts suitable for use solely/principally with motors of heading 8501/8502. Residual electric-motor parts sub-line.
VHF omni range (VOR) equipment (8526.91.50) — radio navigational aid apparatus under 8526.91. Aviation ground/airborne navigation beacon receiver.
Video special effect equipment: video mixing systems or consoles (8543.70.31) — electrical apparatus with individual functions n.e.s. of heading 8543. Broadcast/studio vision mixers.

Diesel-electric hybrid vehicle for transport of <=13 persons (incl. driver), integrated monocoque, air-conditioned (8702.20.11). Heading 8702 = motor vehicles for >=10 persons; 8702.20 = diesel + electric hybrid.
Goods vehicle with only diesel (compression-ignition) engine, g.v.w. not exceeding 5 tonnes (8704.21.00). Light commercial truck of heading 8704.
Other bicycles and cycles, not motorised (8712.00.90) — residual under heading 8712 (e.g., non-standard or other cycles not the named sub-lines).
Cameras specially designed for underwater/aerial-survey/medical-surgical examination, and forensic comparison cameras (9006.30.00). Special-purpose photographic cameras of heading 9006.
Anaesthetic apparatus and instruments (9018.90.41) — instruments used in medical/surgical sciences under heading 9018, 'Other instruments and appliances' group.
Other revolution counters, production counters, taximeters, mileometers, pedometers and the like (9029.10.90) — residual under 9029.10. Counting instruments of heading 9029.
